text1: I build responsive, user-friendly websites with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Next.js. I have been drawn to technology since I was young, and I enjoy turning designs and ideas into clear, working interfaces.
text2: I am organised, reliable and transparent in the way I work, and I learn best in a team. Before moving into development full time, I spent over two years as a web development tutor, reviewing students' code and helping them ship their first responsive websites.
text3: I am currently studying for a Technical Degree in Programming and I am looking for junior front-end opportunities, with a focus on Sweden. I am open to full-time roles, internships, remote work and freelance projects.

projectsDescription.description: Blossom Weddings is a landing page for a fictional wedding planning company, designed to keep all the information in one place. I built separate desktop and mobile layouts, and the page also adapts to tablets and other screen sizes.

Reservando is a UX/UI prototype designed in Adobe XD to help people with gluten intolerance find places where they can eat without worrying. Users can see nearby restaurants and book a table quickly when they are in a hurry.
ArmyDive is a fictional e-commerce site for BTS merchandise and albums. I built it with React and SASS, made it fully responsive, and used Firebase for the backend.

A full-stack dashboard built with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS while following the official Next.js learning course. It includes authentication, a protected dashboard and invoice management, and it helped me practise routing, data fetching and server-side rendering.

A responsive portfolio website for an artist, built by turning a Canva design into code. I created the animations from scratch with SASS, organised her work into clear sections and added direct links to her music.
